name: Aybarian
description: The Aybarian were a sentient species from the Aybaria system in the Outer Rim Territories. At some point before taking back control of Cloud City, Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian played a game of Six-Card Gizka Limit against a spice-drunk Aybarian diplomat, in which he won a Rossmoyne Vitiator Pistol from the diplomat.
